name: pgn-explorer
description: Local-first PGN database explorer: fast import, search, opening explorer, move trees and Stockfish analysis.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @pgnx/core && npm run build -w @pgnx/server && npm run build -w @pgnx/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core --noEmit && tsc -p packages/server --noEmit && tsc -p packages/web --noEmit
